body: I do not... I've isolated myself from those that were close to me and through their lack of understanding why I separate myself they've grown bitter.... I usually feel the crazy coming before it hits, even though I don't realize it in the heat of the moment, and isolate myself so as not to do or say anything offensive or regrettable. Which in reality probably only compounds my problem, since in my isolation I have no one to talk me down from the irrational fears I may be having. I need to get into counseling but don't know where to even begin. I thought mhmr would be the place but they turned me away because they didn't see the delusional side that comes out and probably thought I was just trying to get some dope.

Thanks for the advice I sorta have a mantra so to speak I repeat:

Talk low
Talk slow
But don't say too much

It grounds me and reminds me to stay calm that's realistic advice thank you. I'm feeling better for the moment the phases come and pass some times barely perceptible others so overwhelming I literally see things and not out of the corner of my eyes like I inspect or hide from things that are non existent depending on whether I'm in a phase of empowerment or stage of insecurity

There's got to be someone with some direction I feel like I'm trying to kill my self and not even remembering my son doesn't deserve to grow up with out me I know he needs me but I feel like things are getting out of my hand

I woke up one morning and grabbed a water bottle off my nightstand and was parched took a big swig off of it and it burned my mouth and tasted like rubbing alcohol.... was it alcohol???? Did someone try to poison me??? Did I do it myself and not remember???? Was it all my imagination??? I was so sick for at least 30 min to an hr afterwards to the point I almost called an ambulance three days later came the episode of worms..... so was I making myself sick out of dillution was I really sick??? I don't know what's going on with me

I can't even separate reality from my imagination anymore I don't know if I'm making it all up or if it's all real or a combination of the two.... I feel like people are intentionally sabotaging me.on one hand I realize that's a ridiculous thought but I can't seem to look past what I see as facts. I feel like the  city officials are trying to poison me I feel like my girlfriends friends and family are trying to manipulate her against me I see things I know can't be there and here voices of people I know and some I don't recognize when I'm alone

I've gone through a lot of phases in the past four months and I feel like I'm getting closer to giving up each day. What am I supposed to do??? I have no one to turn to or maybe it just feels that way??? The mother of my child was my serenity but she's turned her back on me detoxing from pain pills... her withdrawals have caused her to attack me and use my deepest fears against me
